To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a high characteristic impedance inverter can be realized with compact dimensions and low loss, which is a critical component for the design of monolithic microwave integrated circuits (MMICs), and in particular Doherty power amplifier (DPA) designs.

a high characteristic impedance impedance inverter, which utilizes the output capacitance, and the output matching network, of the active devices to implement the impedance inverter, can be realized in MMIC technology, with a compact size, and with high characteristic impedance.
the impedance inverter can be used to realize compact Doherty power amplifier MMICs with high output power and efficiency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the implementation of a wideband and compact GaN MMIC- DPA, which has a high output power level, high average PAE, and low adjacent channel power ratio.
the design and implementation of a wideband and compact GaN MMIC- DPA for microwave link application.
the realization of a compact GaN DPA for microwave link application.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Doherty amplifier topology, in combination with an impedance inverter, is a very promising solution for high-efficiency linear amplification.

the proposed Doherty architecture and the proposed compact Tee-network of impedance inverters with the high characteristic impedance, are both suitable and effective for monolithic implementation of DPAs.
the presented design and fabrication of an impedance inverter for MMIC-DPAs is an enabling technology, which is a major step towards the realization of high power and high efficiency GaN MMIC DPAs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a wideband and compact Doherty amplifier with a high output power and high average PAE, and low distortion, has been successfully demonstrated.
the presented Doherty architecture can provide high efficiency, wideband, and compact GaN MMICs for microwave link applications.
the proposed Doherty architecture is a promising candidate for high efficiency, wideband and compact power amplifier design for microwave link applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed impedance inverter can be utilized for the realization of a DPA with compact dimensions, high efficiency, and wide bandwidth.
a high impedance impedance inverter, which is compact and easy to implement, can be utilized in the design of MMIC-DPAs.
impedance inverters can be realized by using the output capacitance and compact transmission lines of active devices.
